summary: This note describes Pathology, an American death metal band from San Diego, California, formed in 2006 by drummer Dave Astor. Dave Astor was previously known for work with The Locust and Cattle Decapitation. The band was signed to Victory Records for over three years and is currently signed to Sevared Records, an independent New York-based death metal label.
one_line: Pathology is a San Diego death metal band formed in 2006 by drummer Dave Astor, now signed to Sevared Records.
